2001.title: Solar eclipse seen across the Pacific
2001.extract: A total solar eclipse was seen on Tuesday by observers on ships and islands across the Pacific Ocean, the first visible from the region in more than a decade. Astronomers said the sky was clear along most of the path of totality, and that the event lasted a little over four minutes at its longest point.
